findings.claim: topLevelArgs does not skip comments, so brackets or quotes inside comments can hide subsequent literal inventory/config arguments. For example, ['scripts/check-x.mjs', roots[0], /* [ */ '--inventory', 'missing.json'] leaves the comment's '[' on the stack and produces argv: [], preventing the missing inventory path from being checked. readArgArray already skips comments; apply equivalent comment handling when splitting top-level arguments and add a missing-path regression test.
